name: labs/graysonbellamy__sartoriuslib
title: Sartorius balance via sartoriuslib
intro: Sartorius balance via sartoriuslib, adapted from graysonbellamy/sartoriuslib. It reads `net_weight`, `gross_weight`, `tare_value`, `stable` and 4 more; sets `display_unit`, `filter_mode`, `auto_zero`, `isocal_mode` and 2 more; runs `measure_mass`. `measure_mass`: measure the mass on a balance or load cell and report the value and stability flag. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
